book_source.review: Hash verification only; no new page or mathematical statement audit.

evidence_policy.sources: Primary upstream docs/local source and project implementation/plan files only.
evidence_policy.agreement: Optional oracle agreement is corroboration; shared dependencies limit independence.
evidence_policy.target_kinds: Desired evidence per feature, not achieved evidence.
evidence_policy.status_mapping: Integrate with F01 vocabulary; do not replace existing CLI verdict contract.
evidence_policy.numerics: Declare precision, conditioning, tolerance/error bounds and seed; never promote sampling to exactness.
evidence_policy.certificates: State checker, arithmetic, trust assumptions, input/source digest and replay outcome.
evidence_policy.examples: Original acceptance proposals, not copied vendor tests or executable product specifications.
